comparisons.peer_topic: Assumption and Repayment of Senior Notes in 2024
comparisons.peer_summary: In connection with the VMware Merger, the company assumed $8,250 million of VMware's senior unsecured notes and repaid $1,250 million of notes upon maturity in August 2024.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom disclosed the repayment of specific senior notes in fiscal year 2024 as part of their debt management activities, though the drivers differed. AMD repaid $750 million of its own 2.95% Xilinx Notes that matured in June 2024. In contrast, Broadcom repaid $1,250 million of 1.000% notes upon maturity in August 2024, an action distinct from the assumption of $8,250 million in VMware notes also disclosed in the same section. While both companies executed repayments upon maturity, Broadcom's disclosure also highlights a significant assumption of debt related to the VMware merger, whereas AMD's note specifically referenced in this comparison was an assumption from the Xilinx acquisition that matured.

Both disclosures reflect routine debt maturity management within the same timeframe, with Intel settling a larger aggregate principal amount compared to AMD's specific note repayment.
